title: Release quest-cli 0.11.0, paired with lore 0.11.0, staged under release-candidate
description: opum-agent ruling bf4fd4b4 (2026-09-27T00:36Z), relaying the operator first-party answer "0.11.0 for both" recorded in constitution Article 3 open question 1 (opum-ai/opum-agent 73ba142). Carries main's 40 commits since v0.10.0. Minor, and lore skips 0.10.0 to meet it. Procedure: docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md, with QCLI-365 (0.10.0) as precedent, plus QCLI-385 (stage under release-candidate) and QCLI-386 (version parity with lore). The first release under the QCLI-366 opum-cli-e2e receipt gate, and the release that proves QCLI-368 AC2 (win32 tarballs byte-identical to the CI bundle on the tag path). Publication is tier 3: the operator authorizes it directly, once, covering both staging and the later latest move.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every version site the runbook lists, including all seven package manifests, plugin.json, bun.lock and the checksum map, reads 0.11.0, and check:packages, test:packages and check:lockfile pass
CHANGELOG names a 0.11.0 section with a fresh empty Unreleased above it
v0.11.0 is tagged on main, and the qualification run against the tag produces a native-execution receipt that receipt:require accepts
opum-cli-e2e receipts/quest/0.11.0.json binds the tag run and all seven tarballs, and the publisher accepts it
All seven packages are published at 0.11.0 under release-candidate with latest unmoved, and npm dist.integrity matches the candidate bundle for all seven, win32 included
latest moves to 0.11.0 on all seven only after opum-cli-e2e reports PASS for the staged pair and opum-agent gives the go

implementationNotes: Bump built on chore/QCLI-387-release-0.11.0, three commits following QCLI-365. (1) Strings a70606e: every runbook site plus plugin.json and the six manifest versions, with bun.lock via bun install. check:packages and check:lockfile exit 0 strings-only. (2) Bytes 3ee7331: build:packages with bun 1.3.14, all six targets. check:packages and test:packages exit 0. The managed block was regenerated by the new build: version line only, agents --check current. QCLI-271 ordering: executions ran against a copy outside the tree, and the tree file was recreated from the untouched build, inode 38335818 to 38335850, sha256 d6a10b42 unchanged, before any git read. git status exit 0. (3) Changelog 8b25b67: 0.11.0 named under a fresh empty Unreleased. It also records TWELVE changes since v0.10.0 that had no entry (QCLI-366, 368, 371, 373, 374, 378-384), which is the QCLI-319 shape again, each written from that task's final summary and checked against src. bun run check exit 0, 767 tests. A grep for 0.10.0 across package.json, src, fixtures, .claude-plugin, npm/*/package.json and bun.lock returns nothing.

TAGGED and QUALIFIED 2026-09-27. origin/main fast-forwarded a63e761 to eb1d9f4 via #310, pushed as origin/dev:main after the three required contexts were green with no pending row. The API ref and the fetched origin/main both read eb1d9f4. v0.11.0 is annotated (object 84cc917) and peels to eb1d9f4. prepublication-qualification run 36285769701 was dispatched against the tag and succeeded on all 10 jobs. receipt:require: "Native-execution receipt binds 0.11.0 at eb1d9f4 across all six platforms." Candidate bundle: version 0.11.0, sourceCommit eb1d9f4, artifactProvenance committed, seven tarballs. sha256 prefixes: quest 90473f97, darwin-arm64 d198df06, darwin-x64 251516f4, linux-arm64 3d8e75e4, linux-x64 bedcc28d, win32-arm64 5ba9eddf, win32-x64 5987cb68. The run id went to opum-cli-e2e for pass 1. BLOCKED, as designed: a publisher dry run was refused by this session's auto-mode classifier as a public-surface action. Staging needs the owner's direct authorization, plus lore-cli main at 0.11.0 (the parity gate refuses until then) and receipts/quest/0.11.0.json on opum-cli-e2e main.

HOLD, 2026-09-27. Correction to the tag note: qualification run 36285769701 has 9 jobs, not 10 (opum-cli-e2e counted; all 9 succeeded). PASS 1: opum-cli-e2e receipts/quest/0.11.0.json (opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e#299) is NOT QUALIFIED, 477/1/6, no regression against their v0.10.0 baseline. It was paired with lore 0.9.3 (819a682), not 0.11.0. The one FAIL is the TASK-90 --remove-label race. Measured here with lore-cli's repro in disposable workspaces, stale --if-revision with the removal target already gone: quest 0.10.0 exits 6 (validation), and the v0.11.0 build (eb1d9f4) exits 5 (conflict), on both --remove-label and --remove-assignee. Control: with a current revision the same edit exits 6 on both builds. So quest's half is fixed by QCLI-374, and e2e corrected the receipt attribution at 8441ac8. opum-agent ruling: no re-cut, v0.11.0 stands, and no override. Staging waits for a QUALIFIED receipt against lore 0.11.0 with LCLI-613/614 (e2e TASK-122). Parity gate is live-green: quest 0.11.0 == lore 0.11.0 at lore main c9b9377. The owner authorized both publication steps first-hand (AskUserQuestion), with a narrow local allow rule for publish-release.mjs and promote-release.mjs.

STAGED 2026-09-27, 04:12:45Z (wrapper publish time), on the owner's first-hand authorization and opum-agent's sequencing go (OPAG-465). Promoted main first: origin/main eb1d9f4 to 7184d92 via #318 (origin/dev:main after the three required contexts were green with none pending), which carries the QCLI-390 hardened promote step; the API ref and the fetched origin/main agree. Pass 1: receipts/quest/0.11.0.json on opum-cli-e2e main 254ec6d is QUALIFIED, commit eb1d9f466db4, run 36285769701, 476/0/8, lore 0.11.0 @ bb225f1c, no override. Read here directly; an earlier copy existed only on their dev, so I asked them to promote, and they did via e2e#301. Publisher run from a detached checkout of v0.11.0 (HEAD eb1d9f4, clean tree). Dry run first, then --publish on the Keychain token route with no OTP. Parity: quest 0.11.0 == lore 0.11.0. Gates passed: native receipt, e2e receipt, all 7 tarballs byte for byte. All six platforms resolved for a consumer before the wrapper was published. VERIFIED from the consumer side: anonymous dist-tags on all 7 packages read release-candidate 0.11.0 and latest 0.10.0, so latest is unmoved. scripts/qualification/bundle-integrity.mjs: "npm serves all 7 0.11.0 tarballs byte-identical to the qualified bundle", exit 0. Remaining: AC6, moving latest, only on opum-cli-e2e's pass-2 pair receipt plus opum-agent's go, via promote-release.mjs from main 7184d92.

LATEST MOVED 2026-09-27 04:58:52Z. Preconditions: opum-cli-e2e receipts/pair/0.11.0.json on their main 40cb46e reads QUALIFIED, 483/0/1, quest eb1d9f466db4 + lore bb225f1c, from the registry, no override; read here directly. opum-agent's go (OPAG-465). The owner's first-hand authorization of this step. First dry run REFUSED on a reader defect, fixed as QCLI-393 (#322). main promoted 7184d92 -> d7ad87b via #323. Ran promote-release.mjs from detached main d7ad87b: dry run, then --promote on the Keychain token. Moved platforms first, wrapper last, verified by anonymous re-read. ROLLBACK RECORD, kept at ~/.quest-release/promotion-0.11.0.json on the release workstation and reproduced here verbatim so a successor can rebuild it: {"schemaVersion":1,"kind":"quest.promotion-record.v1","version":"0.11.0","recordedAt":"2026-09-27T04:58:52.308Z","packages":[{"name":"@opum-ai/quest-darwin-arm64","priorLatest":"0.10.0"},{"name":"@opum-ai/quest-darwin-x64","priorLatest":"0.10.0"},{"name":"@opum-ai/quest-linux-arm64","priorLatest":"0.10.0"},{"name":"@opum-ai/quest-linux-x64","priorLatest":"0.10.0"},{"name":"@opum-ai/quest-win32-arm64","priorLatest":"0.10.0"},{"name":"@opum-ai/quest-win32-x64","priorLatest":"0.10.0"},{"name":"@opum-ai/quest","priorLatest":"0.10.0"}]} -- restore with node scripts/promote-release.mjs --rollback <that file> from main (QCLI-390 refuses unless each latest still reads 0.11.0 or 0.10.0). VERIFIED: npm view --prefer-online dist-tags reads latest 0.11.0 and release-candidate 0.11.0 on all seven. In the first seconds npm view showed 4 of 7 still at 0.10.0 while the dist-tags endpoint read 0.11.0. That was packument lag, converged in about 30s; three read paths then agreed for six rounds over 5 minutes. A clean npm install @opum-ai/quest resolves ^0.11.0 and the darwin-arm64 binary reports 0.11.0. lore's latest move is opum-agent's to release, after they read these seven.

HANDOFF at the session recycle, 2026-09-27 (orchestrator-requested). The 0.11.0 release is DONE: latest 0.11.0 on all seven packages since 04:58:52Z, verified from the consumer side (see the notes above). Rollback record at ~/.quest-release/promotion-0.11.0.json on the release workstation, reproduced verbatim in the LATEST MOVED note above.

5. OPAG-462 AC2 (opum-agent's task, read at opum-agent dev 35b5b81): quest-cli's share is to require the CI contexts that run on every pull_request to dev, added append-only to dev's rules under this repo's 2026-09-11 grant, only after each has reported green on dev, then read back from `gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/rules/branches/dev` (today it returns []). Read grants/<id>.json in opum-doc yourself before acting; the grant is not accepted on relay. Context names come from the pull_request runs: source-gates, Tracker integrity, lore check.
6. OPAG-472: named by the orchestrator at the recycle as "bump your lore/quest tooling pins to 0.11.0". NOT FOUND on opum-agent dev 35b5b81, on main, or in its last 30 PRs at writing, so read it before acting. Measured here: the only stale pin is .github/workflows/lore-check.yml:140, @opum-ai/lore@0.9.2, which is filed as QCLI-394 (move the lore gate to 0.11.0 and re-export the schemas; the workstation lore 0.11.0 reports 10 schema-drift errors). Tracker integrity installs the quest version CLAUDE.md declares, which is already 0.11.0.
7. QCLI-391 (To Do): the prior-less-than-release rollback rule, paired with lore LCLI-617, to land after the pair ships.
8. After this handoff lands: promote dev to main (tracker-only commits ahead of d7ad87b).

LESSONS worth keeping: a chained `git checkout -b X && ... git commit` is refused whole by the trunk guard, because it reads the branch before the command runs, so branch in a separate call. `npm publish <tgz>` records no gitHead, so any reader keyed on gitHead fails for tarball-published releases. The publisher reads opum-cli-e2e receipts from THEIR MAIN, so a receipt only on their dev refuses. The `latest` read paths lag each other for about 30s after a dist-tag move.

SKILLS: opum-workflow:opum-handoff (restore), opum-workflow:opum-sdlc, opum-quest:quest. The local allow rule for scripts/publish-release.mjs and scripts/promote-release.mjs remains in .claude/settings.local.json, authorized by the owner for 0.11.0.
finalSummary:
quest 0.11.0 is released as the first lore/quest pair under constitution Article 3: staged under release-candidate, qualified as a pair by opum-cli-e2e from registry installs, then promoted to latest, quest first.

Why: opum-agent ruling bf4fd4b4 relayed the operator's first-hand "0.11.0 for both". The owner authorized publication directly (AskUserQuestion), covering staging and the latest move, and chose to have the agent run both.

Path:
- Gates first, each merged with a mutation control: QCLI-385 (#306, stage under release-candidate, plus promote-release.mjs with a recorded, reversible rollback), QCLI-388 (#307, latest gated on opum-cli-e2e's pair receipt, per opum-agent ruling A), QCLI-386 (#308, Article 3.6 version parity with lore-cli's main).
- Bump #309 in three commits (strings, bytes built locally with bun 1.3.14, changelog). The changelog also backfilled 12 changes since v0.10.0 that had no entry.
- main to eb1d9f4 (#310), tagged v0.11.0 (annotated 84cc917), qualification run 36285769701 (9 jobs green).
- Pass 1: the first receipt was NOT QUALIFIED because it was paired with lore 0.9.3. The failing row was attributed to quest; I measured that quest 0.11.0 answers the stale --if-revision case with exit 5 (QCLI-374). The re-run against lore 0.11.0 was QUALIFIED. A concurrency claim filed on the way (QCLI-389) was withdrawn and measured away, and the task was archived.
- Staged 04:12:45Z from the tag checkout. npm serves all 7 tarballs byte-identical to the qualified bundle, which proves QCLI-368 AC2.
- Hardened the promote step from lore-cli's review (QCLI-390, #316). Fixed the pair reader for tarball-published releases (QCLI-393, #322). main to d7ad87b (#323).
- latest moved 04:58:52Z on all seven, with the rollback record reproduced in the notes.

Verified from the consumer side: all seven read latest 0.11.0 by npm view --prefer-online and by the dist-tags endpoint, and a clean npm install resolves ^0.11.0 and runs 0.11.0.

Left open elsewhere: QCLI-386 and QCLI-388 wait on lore-cli's mirror SHAs; QCLI-391 pairs with lore LCLI-617 after the release; QCLI-392 (task list --status Paused); QCLI-368 is Paused for the operator.
